seoTitle: Birmingham City Schools Calendar 2026–27 | Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Birmingham City Schools starts Aug. 10, 2026 and ends June 10, 2027. See breaks, intersessions, e-Learning days, official BCS PDFs and an ICS download.
heroSummary:
School starts Monday, August 10, 2026, and the last student day is Thursday, June 10, 2027. Major breaks include Fall Intersession on October 5–9, Thanksgiving Break on November 23–27, Spring Intersession on February 22–26, and Spring Break on March 22–26.

Winter Holidays run December 21–31, but students do not return until Wednesday, January 6. January 1 is a holiday, January 4 is a district professional development day, and January 5 is a teacher workday. December 18 is an early-dismissal day.

calendarFaqs.q: Are October 23 and March 8 no-school days in Birmingham City Schools?
calendarFaqs.a: No. BCS labels both dates as e-Learning / Parent Conference Days, and both count toward the district's 180 student days. Families should follow school instructions for online learning and conference arrangements.

calendarFaqs.q: When do BCS students return after Winter Holidays?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027. January 1 is a holiday, January 4 is a district professional development day and January 5 is a teacher workday.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the difference between BCS intersessions and school breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: The BCS calendar does not explain a policy difference. It labels October 5–9 and February 22–26 as intersessions, while October 30 and March 22–26 are listed as school breaks.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the BCS assessment calendar replace the school event calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The assessment calendar is a separate testing resource. Use the school event calendar for districtwide attendance dates, holidays, intersessions and breaks.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the Birmingham City Schools ICS calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import of the dates reviewed on this page. Check the BCS calendar documents page for a replacement PDF or later district changes.
